long_biography.plain_text:
To make El Nacional’s large dining space work, Gerard Subirats divided the Barcelona venue into smaller restaurants sharing central purchasing. The arrangement combined buying power with smaller kitchen teams and allowed specialist staff to source meat, fish and vegetables. A culinary committee brought chefs together with hotel procurement expertise to develop recipes and establish kitchen procedures.

Subirats has competed in Spain’s cross-country rallies with co-driver Daniel Cámara. He values the sport’s demand for complete concentration and immediate decisions. In 2017, they topped their respective driver and co-driver classifications in the Spanish T1N trophy.
